# Interactive Visualizations

Below are three interactive visualizations related to the project:

## 1. Accident Frequency by Month

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(plotly)
# 示例用的简单图
fig <- plot_ly(
  x = c('Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'),
  y = c(500, 600, 700, 800, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 900, 700, 600, 500),
  type = 'bar'
)
fig
